tha-ap303:1.1: Padumakesariya.] Isisaṅghe ahaṃ pubbe āsiṃ *mātaṅgavāraṇo* / mahesīnaṃ pasādena padumakesaram okiriṃ. // //
tha-ap303:2.1: Paccekajinaseṭṭhesu dhutarāgesu tādisu / tesu cittaṃ pasādetvā kappaṃ saggamhi mod' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap303:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe kesaram okiriṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi *pupphapūjāy'* idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap303:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Padumakesariyo thero i. g. a-ti.
